title: ageratina venulosa
intro: Ageratina venulosa, commonly known as blood flower or venulos leaf, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The health benefits of Ageratina venulosa include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. Therapeutically, Ageratina venulosa has been traditionally used to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina venulosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
